cc:Work.dc:description: Four original lower-row Figure 3 allocations, m/|Gamma_I|=0.1,1,1.5,2.5; insulated fractions 9,22,43,71 percent. Original geometry, colors, colorbar pixels and tick calibration preserved; all labels redrawn in sans-serif.
